technical-summary: RUM04 C42 moves measured-plan cache publication from raw CLI file import into the tracked session owner. Each measurement gets a unique attempt ID and paths; the owner freezes and rechecks effective inputs/build identity, validates ordered ranks and plan configuration, publishes with an exclusive temporary file and atomic rename, and requires the post-store writer to read the same owner receipt. Owner receipts bind manifest, plan/ranks, resident values, cache key and optional native snapshot identity. Native v3 imports require owner provenance; legacy v2 imports and keys remain available.
user-summary-candidate: Measured plans are now published by the session that owns the measurement, with the measured inputs and resident-memory figures tied to a specific attempt. A host-pool retry measures and caches under a new key.
